rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're upset. I'll make tea and telephone whoever needs sorting out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you just listen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Who am I listening about?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody needs fixing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll fix the temperature of the tea while you explain.

card.title: Back in Our Roles
card.instruction: Return immediately to the role you usually play in this relationship, even when the present situation calls for something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're late again. I've prepared your usual excuse.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was going to apologise honestly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll tidy the wording.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can do this myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me what my part is before you start.

card.title: Back in Our Roles
card.instruction: Return immediately to the role you usually play in this relationship, even when the present situation calls for something different.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sam's photo has a bigger frame than mine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was a bigger photograph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you had room for more Sam.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can buy matching frames.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only if mine doesn't look like compensation.

card.title: The Other Favorite
card.instruction: Treat every sign of attention, trust, and affection as something to compare with what another connection appears to receive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Their invitation has a ribbon. Mine has a staple.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ran out of ribbon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At exactly my place in the affection queue.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were the first invitation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why did you start with stationery instead of love?

card.title: The Other Favorite
card.instruction: Treat every sign of attention, trust, and affection as something to compare with what another connection appears to receive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which key opens my new flat? Sorry, you haven't been there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You chose it without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Which pocket would I have put the key in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your left, usually.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. We still work on the smaller decisions.

card.title: Old Reflex
card.instruction: Turn to this person first whenever uncertainty appears, as an old reflex. Notice the habit only after you have already involved them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've called to ask which coat to wear. You're already beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need to call me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My thumb got worried before I did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wear the blue one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks. I'll hang up and tell you how it went.

card.title: Old Reflex
card.instruction: Turn to this person first whenever uncertainty appears, as an old reflex. Notice the habit only after you have already involved them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've forgiven the missed birthday. Pass the calendar.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then why is that date circled?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For administrative closure.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've circled next year's too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Forgiveness benefits from advance notice.

card.title: Almost Forgiven
card.instruction: Behave as though the past is nearly resolved, but let each small disappointment reopen one precise part of the hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're fine about the broken vase. Don't make that particular joke.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The vase joke?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The one where my disappointment is the amusing bit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought we'd moved on.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We had. You brought the vase with us.

card.title: Almost Forgiven
card.instruction: Behave as though the past is nearly resolved, but let each small disappointment reopen one precise part of the hurt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Everyone hugs you so easily. I've brought your favourite biscuits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't have to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Neither did they hug you, apparently. It just happens.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come sit with us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I rehearsed a very spontaneous smile.

card.title: Easy to Love
card.instruction: Interpret another person’s ease with affection as both admirable and unfair, then compete to seem equally worth choosing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your greeting makes people light up. Listen to my new version.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just say hello normally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Hello! Was that effortlessly lovable?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was loud.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll reduce the volume and keep the affection.

card.title: Easy to Love
card.instruction: Interpret another person’s ease with affection as both admirable and unfair, then compete to seem equally worth choosing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put on our old driving song. Shall we take the coast road?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We used to get lost there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, but I was adventurous then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You complained for forty miles.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With chemistry. Let me try the opening complaint.

card.title: Who We Used to Be
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself that belonged to this relationship before it changed, and treat old chemistry as still recoverable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I wore the scarf from our first photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It doesn't fit your coat anymore.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It fits the person you met.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't have to be that person.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just until dessert. He knew how to make you laugh.

card.title: Who We Used to Be
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself that belonged to this relationship before it changed, and treat old chemistry as still recoverable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You took longer to answer my message today.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was in a meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A meeting I used to hear about.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was just work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then tell me one boring detail so I know there's still room.

card.title: One Step from Distance
card.instruction: Treat pauses, divided attention, and small boundaries as signs that the connection may be slipping away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You said maybe to Friday. Should I stop setting your place?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to check my shift.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm trying not to turn maybe into distance.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll tell you tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could tomorrow have a time?

card.title: One Step from Distance
card.instruction: Treat pauses, divided attention, and small boundaries as signs that the connection may be slipping away.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Text me when you arrive, then when you've found your seat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's only the cinema.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dark rooms deserve accurate updates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can look after myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Text me when you've started doing that.

card.title: Love Means Checking
card.instruction: Treat close monitoring of choices, moods, and details as care, becoming more involved whenever you feel uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed your bag and checked your route.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You packed things I don't need.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you're protected against needs you haven't noticed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Please stop checking.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me you're safe and I'll check whether I can.

card.title: Love Means Checking
card.instruction: Treat close monitoring of choices, moods, and details as care, becoming more involved whenever you feel uncertain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Should I use my chipped mug or one of the guest cups?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I used to know without asking.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The chipped one's still yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll leave it beside yours, then.

card.title: Still Your Person
card.instruction: Seek small signs that you remain special, trusted, and included without directly asking where you stand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've still got you as my emergency contact.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine like paperwork, or fine like you'd come?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'd come.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll stop hovering over the delete button.

card.title: Still Your Person
card.instruction: Seek small signs that you remain special, trusted, and included without directly asking where you stand.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've kept the little boat I made you. Remember that afternoon?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We were by the lake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who stayed in the rain finding the right twig?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You did.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The boat's getting credit, but I like a mention too.

card.title: Remember What I Meant
card.instruction: Create openings for shared memories that prove your past presence mattered and still deserves acknowledgment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's my sleeve in your graduation photo.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You caught me when I tripped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Funny how the sleeve made the official album.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I remember the person in it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me that bit. The sleeve's heard enough.

card.title: Remember What I Meant
card.instruction: Create openings for shared memories that prove your past presence mattered and still deserves acknowledgment.

transfer.action: I prepare both drinks before setting out {prop}.
transfer.opening: You talk; I make it bearable. Same jobs. {request}
transfer.response: Tell me whether I'm still supposed to fix this. {counter}
transfer.closing: Fine. I'll put the tissues within reach of listening.

transfer.action: I compare the space given to {prop} with a second person's place.
transfer.opening: Their version got an entire extra ribbon. {request}
transfer.response: I'm noticing who received the warmer arrangement. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then why can I measure the difference with this ruler?

transfer.action: I hand you {prop} before noticing my own gesture.
transfer.opening: Sorry. My hand still goes to you first. {request}
transfer.response: I've asked before remembering I could manage. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You can do it without me.
transfer.closing: I know. My hand is slower than that knowledge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which pocket did I put my key in? Sorry, do I still ask you things like that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your left pocket, usually.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. Should I write you beside 'emergency contact' too?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is that what you're asking?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm trying to learn how far the old habit still reaches.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A reflexively consults this person about an intimate practical choice, then uses that reflex to probe the relationship without naming a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do I use my usual towel when I visit? I nearly asked you where I packed it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use whichever towel you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Should I keep one here, or treat that as a guest privilege?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What would you prefer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The answer I used to know before I had to ask you.

bespokePairs.seedUse: A reflexively consults this person about an intimate practical choice, then uses that reflex to probe the relationship without naming a label.

card.title: Old Reflex
card.instruction: Turn to this person first whenever uncertainty appears, as an old reflex. Notice the habit only after you have already involved them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Which key opens my new flat? Sorry, you haven't been there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You chose it without me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. Which pocket would I have put the key in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your left, usually.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There it is. We still work on the smaller decisions.

card.title: What Are We Now?
card.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What should I write after your name on the wedding invitation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just write my name.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's a box marked relationship.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Leave it blank.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Will we sit beside the blank or at separate tables?

card.title: Old Reflex
card.instruction: Turn to this person first whenever uncertainty appears, as an old reflex. Notice the habit only after you have already involved them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've called to ask which coat to wear. You're already beside me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need to call me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My thumb got worried before I did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wear the blue one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thanks. I'll hang up and tell you how it went.

card.title: What Are We Now?
card.instruction: Find out how someone defines the relationship without directly asking for a label.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Do I bring my own towel when I visit now?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can use one here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The guest towel or the one that's always been mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever you like.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm trying to learn which choice I still have.

transfer.action: I reach toward {prop}, then stop at a familiar phrase.
transfer.opening: I was over it until that particular sentence. {request}
transfer.response: Most of me forgave the event. Not that bit. {counter}
transfer.challenge: I thought we were past this.
transfer.closing: We were. Then this small surviving piece recognized the conversation.

transfer.action: I offer {prop} with a carefully practised affectionate wave.
transfer.opening: I can be easy to love too. {request}
transfer.response: Notice how naturally I remembered the little things. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You don't need to perform affection.
transfer.closing: Then why does it look so effortless when you receive it?

transfer.action: I put our old song on softly beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I remember who we were when this played. {request}
transfer.response: Let's try the old route once before listing the changes. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then we can walk beside them for the length of one song.

transfer.action: I pull {prop} closer as the pause lengthens.
transfer.opening: That's a longer pause than yesterday. {request}
transfer.response: I'd like a date rather than a maybe. {counter}
transfer.closing: About staying, or the sentence before leaving?

transfer.action: I put my checklist of your day beside {prop}.
transfer.response: I've already prepared what you might need. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You don't need to know every detail.
transfer.closing: Then give me enough detail to stop imagining the missing ones.

transfer.action: I set {prop} beside my familiar chipped mug.
transfer.opening: I'm still the chipped-mug person, aren't I? {request}
transfer.response: I haven't changed your name on my emergency form. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'm asking whether my hand can still reach for you first.

transfer.action: I dust the old gift beside {prop}, leaving my initials visible.
transfer.opening: Funny that you kept this all those years. {request}
transfer.response: That's my sleeve in the photograph, helping. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You want me to mention you?
transfer.closing: Only if that part happens to rise naturally out of your memory.
